memory1.comment: Measured 2026-11-17 by comparing a post-etch unpatterned-oxide probe grid (12x12) per SPX layer name against the polygon coverage of every GDS layer: 144/144 agreement for each pair, and the polarity is negative (litho removes resist where the layer has polygons). BC/layer 17 is weakly evidenced: its 16 contact rectangles are smaller than the probe pitch, so the grid saw no coverage on both sides.

litho.comment: SPX litho_patterning coats a fresh resist layer on top before clearing the openings; measured 0.1 um (resist top 0.15 -> 0.25 on the recorded case). The ViennaPS adapter reproduces it via step.parameters.coat (default 0.1) so both sides produce the same solid, not just the same outline.
